newsitem.title: USA: CME April and June hog futures up limit on Taiwan.
newsitem.headline: CME April and June hog futures up limit on Taiwan.

text.p: CME April and June hog futures ran up for limit gains of 2.000 cents per lb the third consecutive day on Taiwan's ban on pork exports imposed last week, traders said.

April was up the limit at 74.275 cents and June up limit at 82.150 cents. Other months were up 1.175 to 1.700 cents with June through October and distant April and June posting new contract highs on the advance.
The Taiwan ban is expected to influence the market for some time to come, traders said.
